$comment: Per-school configuration for resolve_programme_links.py: which already harvested school-owned
programme records count, which domains a school's programme pages may live on, and which
catalogue/sitemap pages to read when discovering more. Adding a school means adding entries here;
it never means typing a link per programme. Entry URLs are read by the crawler; the specific
programme page a row points at is still decided by exact title/degree/language matching.
Ordered by the number of MŠMT register rows each school has (docs/ACCEPTANCE.md A100): the first
twelve schools hold roughly three quarters of the register, so they are configured first. An
empty entryUrls means 'discover generically': the school home page is read, its catalogue-like
links are followed one hop, and the school's sitemaps are read within the documented bounds.
